title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials advise residents to keep pets out of Ames Pond after a dog's death, suspecting an algae bloom.
Ames Pond is tested weekly for E. Coli, but algae blooms are suspected of causing harm to pets.
Algae blooms, or cyanobacterial blooms, are rapidly occurring and can be harmful to both people and animals.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, a former NH State Trooper, was decertified for lying about using GPS to track his girlfriend.
Lamoureux placed GPS devices on both his and his girlfriend's vehicles and falsely claimed others were responsible.
He received a suspended six-month prison sentence and must resign, losing future law enforcement employment eligibility.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Police responded to Grace Chapel in Lexington after reports of a man with a gun, initiating a lockdown.
The suspect was polishing a powder horn outside his vehicle, mistaking it for a gun triggered police response.
Lexington police confirmed no threat, attributing incident to misidentification during semiquincentennial celebrations.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will make playoffs despite their strong performance and current wild-card spot.
The Red Sox have won 32 of their last 38 games, making them MLB's best since July 3.
FanGraphs estimates Red Sox have a 96% chance of making playoffs; Parker stands by prediction they won't.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling from Friday's game.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game against the Athletics after receiving more treatment.
Abreu has 20 home runs, 62 RBIs, and a .256 average in 2026, making him a key player this season.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Red Sox lost 7-3 to the Athletics, ending their nine-game winning streak.
Pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings in his 13th start.
Despite the loss, the Red Sox remain in possession of the AL's second wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium will install a new turf surface for the Patriots' preseason game due to an NFL rule.
The current turf did not pass NFL lab tests as it lacks an 'E-layer,' required for stadiums without concrete sub-bases.
The turf being reinstalled is the same version used by the Patriots and Revolution in 2025.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, despite Jack Harrison's debut.
Houston Dynamo scored through Guilherme and Agustin Resch, exploiting New England's defensive mistakes.
Revolution's attack struggled as Houston effectively countered, with Diego Fagundez unable to break through.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony resumes training by hitting off a pitching machine as he recovers from a wrist injury.
Adley Rutschman made his first rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching five innings.
Rutschman, a recent trade acquisition, is expected to join the Red Sox lineup soon as their everyday catcher.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless', 'Eighth Grade', and 'Something's Gotta Give' are recommended Netflix films for August 2026.
New streaming picks include 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' on Paramount+ and 'You, Me & Tuscany' on Peacock.
Boston.com's staff recommends shows such as 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 on Paramount+ and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 on Apple TV.
